high_level_description: The image is a bar chart titled "TOTAL NUMBER OF H-1B VISAS." It provides data on the number of H-1B visas issued over several years, from 2000 to 2015. The chart includes three sets of bars: Annual Cap: Represented by a black line at the bottom of the chart. Visas Issued: Represented by blue bars. Total Valid Visas: Represented by orange bars. The annual cap for H-1B visas is set at 85,000
